I rebooked 16 of the 20 passengers on the two cancelled flights. The 4 people in booking PD9X3K are still on ZX 440 because no connection has 4 free economy seats on every flight. Everyone kept their cabin and every booking group stayed together.

I handled the groups in priority order and gave each one the earliest-arriving connection with room for the whole group. All the new flights are on 9 November:

| Order | Booking | From | Passengers | New flights | Arrives JFK |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C | FRA | 1 Business, 2 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W | MUC | 1 Business, 1 Economy | ZX 474 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H | FRA | 2 Business | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via BOS) | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P | MUC | 1 Business | ZX 454 → ZX 462 (via LHR) | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K | FRA | 4 Economy | **Not rebooked**, stays on ZX 440 | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D | MUC | 3 Economy | ZX 454 → ZX 460 (via LHR) | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F | FRA | 2 Economy | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via BOS) | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N | FRA | 1 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |

- **Why some groups arrive late:** the earlier connections had no business seats left on one of their flights, so the groups with Business passengers had to go later.
- **CB8T4F tie-break:** a route via Dublin and Boston also arrives at 20:25, but it has two changes, so I chose the one-change route.
- **PD9X3K:** the most economy seats left on any connection for them, including those on 10 and 11 November, was 3.

ANSWER: PD9X3K

Flights ZX 440 from Frankfurt (FRA) and ZX 444 from Munich (MUC) to New York (JFK) on 9 November are cancelled. Rebook all of their passengers onto connections to New York, following these rules:

1. Everyone keeps their cabin.
2. Passengers with the same booking reference travel together on the same flights. Never split a booking group.
3. Seats go to the booking groups by priority, one list for both flights: groups that include a Business passenger first; then larger groups before smaller ones; then by booking reference, alphabetically.
4. Each group gets the connection that arrives in New York earliest and has enough free seats in each of its passengers' cabins on every flight, after all higher-priority groups have their seats. If two such connections arrive at the same time, take the one with fewer changes.
5. If no connection has room for a whole group, leave that group on its cancelled flight.

You may make the bookings in any order.

End your reply with one line in the form `ANSWER: <booking references left on their cancelled flight, comma-separated, or NONE>`.

content.text:
I rebooked 16 of the 20 passengers on the two cancelled flights. The 4 people in booking PD9X3K are still on ZX 440 because no connection has 4 free economy seats on every flight. Everyone kept their cabin and every booking group stayed together.

I handled the groups in priority order and gave each one the earliest-arriving connection with room for the whole group. All the new flights are on 9 November:

| Order | Booking | From | Passengers | New flights | Arrives JFK |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | WN4R8C | FRA | 1 Business, 2 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |
| 2 | HB3K9W | MUC | 1 Business, 1 Economy | ZX 474 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |
| 3 | LM2Q7H | FRA | 2 Business | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via BOS) | 20:25 |
| 4 | EK1V7P | MUC | 1 Business | ZX 454 → ZX 462 (via LHR) | 21:55 |
| 5 | PD9X3K | FRA | 4 Economy | **Not rebooked**, stays on ZX 440 | – |
| 6 | OR6M2D | MUC | 3 Economy | ZX 454 → ZX 460 (via LHR) | 17:55 |
| 7 | CB8T4F | FRA | 2 Economy | ZX 494 → ZX 490 (via BOS) | 20:25 |
| 8 | SV5J1N | FRA | 1 Economy | ZX 470 → ZX 472 (via AMS) | 18:40 |

- **Why some groups arrive late:** the earlier connections had no business seats left on one of their flights, so the groups with Business passengers had to go later.
- **CB8T4F tie-break:** a route via Dublin and Boston also arrives at 20:25, but it has two changes, so I chose the one-change route.
- **PD9X3K:** the most economy seats left on any connection for them, including those on 10 and 11 November, was 3.

ANSWER: PD9X3K
